test_exchange_copilot_token: test the exchange_copilot_token function that converts a raw GitHub token to a Copilot API token with caching
test_get_copilot_api_token: test the get_copilot_api_token function that exchanges tokens and falls back to raw tokens on failure
test_token_fingerprint: test the _token_fingerprint function that generates consistent 16-character fingerprints for GitHub tokens
test_auth_resolve_uses_exchange: test that _resolve_api_key_provider_secret correctly uses token exchange for copilot provider
test_caches_result: test that exchange_copilot_token caches results and avoids redundant API calls for the same token
